import scanpy as sc, numpy as np
ad=sc.read_h5ad('raw_counts.h5ad')
ad.var['mt']=ad.var_names.str.startswith('MT-'); ad.var['hb']=ad.var_names.str.contains('^HB[AB]',regex=True)
sc.pp.calculate_qc_metrics(ad,qc_vars=['mt','hb'],inplace=True)
keep=(ad.obs.n_genes_by_counts>=500)&(ad.obs.n_genes_by_counts<5500)&(ad.obs.pct_counts_mt<15)&(ad.obs.pct_counts_hb<20)
ad=ad[keep].copy()
print('kept',ad.shape)
ad.layers['counts']=ad.X.copy()
sc.pp.normalize_total(ad,target_sum=1e4)
sc.pp.log1p(ad)
ad.raw=ad
sc.pp.highly_variable_genes(ad,n_top_genes=3000,flavor='seurat')
print('HVG',ad.var.highly_variable.sum())
sc.pp.scale(ad,max_value=10)
sc.tl.pca(ad,n_comps=50,use_highly_variable=True,svd_solver='arpack')
sc.pp.neighbors(ad,n_neighbors=15,n_pcs=40)
sc.tl.umap(ad,random_state=42)
for r in [.4,.6,.8,1.0,1.2]: sc.tl.leiden(ad,resolution=r,key_added=f'leiden_{r}',random_state=42)
print({c:ad.obs[c].value_counts().sort_index().to_dict() for c in ad.obs.columns if c.startswith('leiden')})
ad.write_h5ad('processed.h5ad')

print(ad.obs.cell_type.value_counts())

X=X.multiply((1e4/lib)[:,None]) if issparse(X) else X*(1e4/lib[:,None])
